situations.title: 원내 이송 전 안정성 평가
situations.tagline: Before we move him to CT, is he stable enough to leave the unit?
situations.brief: 이송 적합성을 판단하기 위해 원내 이송 전 안정성을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: His vitals are stable enough for transport right now.
I'll confirm the airway and lines are secure first.
If he deteriorates, we hold and reassess.

situations.title: 이송 장비·산소·약물 준비
situations.tagline: Let's pack the transport bag — oxygen, monitor, and emergency meds.
situations.brief: 이송백과 모니터를 갖추고 이송 장비와 산소, 약물을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I've calculated the oxygen supply for the full trip plus reserve.
The transport monitor is charged and set up.
Emergency meds and a bag-valve mask are in the bag.

situations.title: 이송 중 모니터·라인 관리
situations.tagline: Keep eyes on the monitor and make sure no lines snag as we move.
situations.brief: 연속 감시를 유지하며 이송 중 모니터와 라인을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm watching the monitor continuously during transport.
All lines are secured and free of tension.
The oxygen tubing is clear of the wheels.

situations.title: 시술 진정 전 사정·동의
situations.tagline: Before we sedate her, let's confirm her ASA class and fasting status.
situations.brief: ASA 등급과 금식 여부를 확인하며 시술 진정 전 사정과 동의를 완료하세요.
keyPhrases: I've documented her ASA class and last oral intake.
The airway assessment and consent are complete.
Reversal agents and suction are at the bedside.

situations.title: 시술 진정 중 활력·기도 감시
situations.tagline: Watch her airway and sats closely — sedation can drop her breathing fast.
situations.brief: 호흡억제를 경계하며 시술 진정 중 활력과 기도를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm monitoring capnography and oxygen saturation continuously.
Her respiratory rate is slowing — I'll stimulate and support the airway.
Suction and the reversal agent are ready.

situations.title: 시술 후 회복 관찰
situations.tagline: Let's watch her recovery — she needs to meet criteria before we relax monitoring.
situations.brief: recovery 기준을 확인하며 시술 후 회복을 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: She's arousable and protecting her own airway now.
Vitals are back to baseline and stable.
She meets the recovery criteria for reduced monitoring.
goals: 시술 후 회복 기준 충족을 확인한다

situations.title: 인공호흡 환자 이송 관리
situations.tagline: He's vented — let's switch him to the transport ventilator and confirm settings before we roll.
situations.brief: 이동형 환기를 유지하며 인공호흡 환자의 이송을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I've matched the transport vent settings to his current ones.
End-tidal CO2 and the ETT depth are confirmed.
I have a bag-valve mask ready as backup.

situations.title: 이송 중 승압·주입 유지
situations.tagline: Keep his pressors running without interruption while we transfer him.
situations.brief: 무중단 titration으로 이송 중 승압제와 주입을 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: The pumps are on battery and running without interruption.
I'll titrate the pressor to keep his MAP at goal.
I've got backup syringes drawn in case a line runs dry.

situations.title: 시술 진정 깊이 적정
situations.tagline: I want her at moderate sedation, not deep — can you titrate to that level?
situations.brief: moderate와 deep 수준을 구분하며 시술 진정 깊이를 적정하세요.
keyPhrases: At moderate sedation she responds to voice and keeps her airway.
I'll titrate slowly and reassess her depth.
If she goes too deep, I'll support the airway and hold the drug.

situations.title: 진정 역전제 준비
situations.tagline: Have naloxone and flumazenil drawn up in case she over-sedates.
situations.brief: naloxone과 flumazenil을 갖춰 진정 역전제를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Naloxone is drawn up for opioid reversal.
Flumazenil is ready for benzodiazepine oversedation.
I'll titrate reversal to effect and watch for resedation.

situations.title: 이송 중 악화 대비 계획
situations.tagline: If he crashes in the elevator, what's our plan — walk me through it.
situations.brief: 비상 대응을 위해 이송 중 악화에 대비한 계획을 세우세요.
keyPhrases: If he arrests, we stop, start compressions, and call for help.
I know where the nearest code cart and phone are on the route.
You manage the airway, I'll run the meds.
goals: 이송 중 악화 시 대응 계획을 수립한다

situations.title: 베드사이드 시술 보조
situations.tagline: Let's do the time-out and set out the supplies for the bedside chest tube.
situations.brief: 타임아웃과 물품을 갖춰 흉관과 기관지경 등 베드사이드 시술을 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's do the time-out — patient, procedure, and site confirmed.
The sterile tray and suction are set up and ready.
I'll monitor her vitals and hand you supplies as needed.

situations.title: 병원간 이송 인계·문서
situations.tagline: The transport team is here — let's hand off with a clear report and paperwork.
situations.brief: 이송 인수인계를 위해 병원간 이송의 인계와 문서를 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll give an SBAR handoff to the transport team.
The chart, imaging, and medication list are all together.
Here are his current drips and their rates.

situations.title: 검사실 안전
situations.tagline: Before we go into the MRI, is every piece of equipment on him MRI-compatible?
situations.brief: MRI와 CT 환경에서 장비 호환성을 확인하며 검사실 안전을 지키세요.
keyPhrases: I've screened all equipment for MRI compatibility.
No ferrous items go past the zone line.
We'll use an MRI-safe monitor and infusion pump.
goals: MRI 안전 구역과 장비 호환성을 확인한다

situations.title: 이송 위험-이익 판단 소통
situations.tagline: Is this scan worth the risk of moving her right now — let's decide together.
situations.brief: 결정 근거를 공유하며 이송의 위험과 이익을 함께 판단해 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: The scan could change management, but she's borderline stable.
Let's weigh the benefit against the transport risk.
If we go, we optimize her first and prepare for problems.

situations.title: 이송 중 심정지 대응
situations.tagline: He just lost his pulse in the hallway — stop the bed and start compressions!
situations.brief: 이동 중 소생을 위해 이송 중 심정지에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the bed — no pulse, starting compressions now.
Call a code and get the nearest crash cart.
I'm bagging him while you push the code meds.
goals: 이동 중 심정지를 즉시 인지하고 소생을 시작한다

situations.title: 이송 중 발관·라인 이탈 위기
situations.tagline: The tube shifted when we moved him — I think he's extubated, bag him now!
situations.brief: 재확보를 위해 이송 중 발관과 라인 이탈 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The ETT is out — I'm bagging him with the mask now.
Call for the airway kit and get us back to the unit.
Hold pressure on the dislodged line.

situations.title: 시술 진정 중 호흡정지 위기
situations.tagline: She stopped breathing under sedation — bag her and give the reversal!
situations.brief: 역전과 환기로 시술 진정 중 호흡정지 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: She's apneic — I'm bagging her with a good seal.
Give the reversal agent and stop all sedatives.
Prepare to intubate if she doesn't recover.

situations.title: 시술 중 대량출혈 급변
situations.tagline: We're getting brisk bleeding — we need to convert this to an emergency now!
situations.brief: 응급 전환을 위해 시술 중 대량출혈 급변에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Bleeding is brisk — apply pressure and open fluids wide.
Activate the massive transfusion protocol and call surgery.
We're converting this to an emergency procedure.

situations.title: MRI 중 응급상황 대응
situations.tagline: She's crashing inside the scanner — get her out of the magnet before we do anything!
situations.brief: 반출과 소생을 위해 MRI 중 발생한 응급상황에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We have to move her out of the magnet room to resuscitate.
No code cart enters the MRI suite — evacuate her to the safe zone.
Start compressions the moment we clear the magnet.
goals: 환자를 자석 구역 밖으로 안전하게 반출한다

situations.title: 이송 중 산소·전원 소진 위기
situations.tagline: The oxygen tank is nearly empty and the monitor battery's dying — what's our backup?
situations.brief: 백업과 대응으로 이송 중 산소와 전원 소진 위기를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: The tank is almost empty — switch to the backup cylinder now.
I'll bag him on room air if we run out entirely.
Find the nearest wall oxygen and power source.
goals: 산소와 전원 소진을 인지하고 백업으로 전환한다
